adjudication.rationale: In packages/core/EventManager.ts, createAllCalendarEvents now treats destinationCalendar as an array and, for a destination lacking credentialId, executes the legacy branch: it finds all credentials with c.type === destination.integration and calls createEvent(c, event) without passing destination.externalId. In parallel, GoogleCalendarService.createEvent was changed to select the target calendar via calEventRaw.destinationCalendar.find(cal => cal.credentialId === credentialId)?.externalId, falling back to "primary" when no match is found. For legacy destinations (no credentialId), this guarantees no match, so Google inserts into "primary" even if destination.externalId exists. Additionally, CalendarManager.createEvent returns externalId from its third argument, but the legacy branch doesn’t provide it, so result.externalId is undefined and downstream code (EventManager uses result.externalId for externalCalendarId) will lose the externalCalendarId reference. This can also multiply inserts across all credentials of that integration (duplicate events) because the legacy branch iterates over all matching credentials.
